group: jsonNodeReader is null – delegate to ObjectMapper

cases.expected: JsonNode representing an object with a single field "key" equal to "value"
cases.description: When jsonNodeReader is null the method should obtain a JSON ObjectMapper via getObjectMapper(JSON) and parse the stream successfully.

cases.expected: JsonNode representing an object with a single field "key" equal to "value"
cases.description: When jsonNodeReader is null the method should obtain a YAML ObjectMapper via getObjectMapper(YAML) and parse the YAML stream successfully.

cases.expected: IOException thrown (or JsonProcessingException wrapped as IOException) because the input stream is empty/invalid JSON

group: jsonNodeReader is provided – delegate to JsonNodeReader

cases.expected: JsonNode returned by the mocked JsonNodeReader containing field "a" with numeric value 1
cases.description: When jsonNodeReader is non‑null the method must call jsonNodeReader.readTree(content, inputFormat) and return its result.

cases.expected: JsonNode returned by the mocked JsonNodeReader representing the YAML content
cases.description: Same as above but with YAML format – ensures the format argument is passed through unchanged.

cases.expected: IOException thrown by the mocked JsonNodeReader
cases.description: If the JsonNodeReader encounters malformed content it should throw IOException, which must propagate unchanged.

cases.expected: IOException or NullPointerException thrown by the mocked JsonNodeReader
cases.description: When the InputStream is null the JsonNodeReader implementation is expected to fail; the factory method must not swallow the exception.

cases.expected: NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) thrown by getObjectMapper when inputFormat is null
cases.description: When jsonNodeReader is null and the caller passes a null InputFormat, the factory should not silently accept it – the underlying getObjectMapper call is expected to raise an NPE (or a specific IllegalArgumentException). The exception must propagate to the caller.

cases.expected: IllegalStateException thrown by the mocked JsonNodeReader propagates unchanged
cases.description: If a custom JsonNodeReader implementation throws an unchecked exception (e.g., IllegalStateException) while reading the stream, JsonSchemaFactory.readTree must not catch it; the exception should bubble up to the caller.

cases.expected: null (the method returns the null value produced by JsonNodeReader)
cases.description: When a non‑null JsonNodeReader returns null (simulating a reader that decides the content cannot be parsed), JsonSchemaFactory.readTree should simply return null without throwing an exception.

cases.expected: IOException (or JsonProcessingException) thrown because JSON mapper cannot parse YAML content
cases.description: Passing YAML text while requesting JSON parsing should cause the underlying ObjectMapper to fail and throw an IOException.

cases.expected: JsonNode representing an object with field "k" equal to "v" (YAML parser accepts JSON as a subset)
cases.description: YAML parser in Jackson can parse valid JSON. This test verifies that when the format is YAML but the content is JSON, the method still succeeds and returns the correct JsonNode.

cases.expected: IOException thrown by ObjectMapper.readTree due to underlying stream read failure
cases.description: When the supplied InputStream throws an IOException during read, the factory method must let that exception propagate (it is not caught internally).

cases.expected: NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) thrown by the mocked JsonNodeReader because the inputFormat argument is null
cases.description: When jsonNodeReader is non‑null the factory method delegates directly to jsonNodeReader.readTree. Supplying a null InputFormat should cause the JsonNodeReader implementation to reject the argument and throw an NPE/IAE, which must propagate unchanged.

group: jsonNodeReader provided – input stream read error propagation

cases.expected: IOException thrown by the mocked JsonNodeReader due to underlying stream read failure
cases.description: If the supplied InputStream throws an IOException while the JsonNodeReader is reading, the JsonSchemaFactory.readTree method must let that IOException propagate (it does not catch it internally).
